headline_pain: What Does Off the Plan Even Mean?
primary_text: "I don't even know how buying off the plan works for commercial property." What if someone explained it without the jargon? Off the plan simply means you buy a warehouse before it's built — at a locked-in price. You put down a deposit, construction happens, and you settle when it's done. You get a brand-new space without the renovation headaches. New warehouses in Truganina designed for small business owner-occupiers. 20km from Melbourne CBD. Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel access. Got questions? We have plain-English answers. No sales pressure.
description: Plain-English guidance with no jargon and no sales pressure
